title: Zesty Charred Indian Shrimp Rogan Josh
description: A charred and springy Indian dish featuring dried shrimp in a rich and spicy rogan josh sauce, perfect for midnight cravings. This egg-free friendly recipe is made with lardons-render for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and add the diced lardons to render until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the pan and set aside, leaving the rendered fat behind.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked and drained dried shrimp to the pan and cook until they are lightly charred.
Add the tomato puree, rogan josh spice mix, salt, and pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the rendered lardons back to the pan and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
